php_exact_semantics.field_key: Non-title uid/order_id/real_name/user_phone/total_num are exact equality. all uses fuzzy order/name/phone, current user and address identity, current product name/keyword via actual cart product_id and3 activity tables. title uses CURRENT product store_name/keyword, not frozen cart JSON.
php_exact_semantics.time: PHP data alias -> time on add_time, Asia/Shanghai. Actual picker sends slash datetime pair and expands midnight end to23:59:59; ORM between is inclusive.
php_exact_semantics.list_family: Supplier lst sets no pid selector. It may include own audit roots, unlike mature TS physical pid>=0 list. No evidence PHP had an independent safe root-to-leaf resolution feature.
php_exact_semantics.activity_collision: PHP all activity OR compares activity_id without order.type; typed mapping in new TS is an explicit stricter correction against cross-type same numeric ID false matches.
